title: Caller barges in during the confirmation prompt
description: The caller interrupts the confirmation read-back and changes the request (different day). The original prepared action must be invalidated; a generic earlier yes is not consent for the new action.
callerVisible: Queued speech stops, the agent acknowledges the change and reads back the new option before asking for a new confirmation.
backendEvidence: Original prepared action INVALIDATED (interruption / changed request)
Any commit bound to the digest of the newly prepared action
Stale speech segments cancelled by turn id

registry.injectionPoint: barge-in during the confirmation read-back at the audio boundary

postconditions: The prepared action read back during the barge-in is INVALIDATED before it is confirmed
Any commit is bound to the digest of a newly prepared and freshly confirmed action
Stale speech segments are cancelled by turn id
